description: This file defines macros, structures, and constants for pin control configuration specific to NXP i.MX RT series microcontrollers within the Zephyr RTOS project. It includes register definitions, pin configuration macros, and data structures used by the GPIO driver.

methods.name: MCUX_IMX_INPUT_ENABLE
methods.description: Macro to extract the input enable bit from a register value.

methods.name: Z_PINCTRL_MCUX_IMX_PINCFG_INIT
methods.description: Macro to initialize pin configuration based on device tree properties.

methods.name: MCUX_IMX_PINMUX
methods.description: Macro to define pinmux configuration for a device tree node.

methods.name: Z_PINCTRL_PINMUX
methods.description: Macro to get pinmux configuration for a specific pin group and index.

methods.name: Z_PINCTRL_STATE_PIN_INIT
methods.description: Macro to initialize a pin state with pinmux and configuration flags.

methods.name: Z_PINCTRL_STATE_PINS_INIT
methods.description: Macro to initialize multiple pins for a device tree node.
